title: Ubusabe bwo kugura
description: Cunga ubusabe bwo kugura ku isoko ry’igerageza.
newRequestDescription: Tangaza ubusabe bwo guhabwa ibiciro (RFQ) bufunguye. Iyo uguze igicuruzwa cyashyizwe ku isoko, ukigurisha abimenyeshwa mu gice cy’amasezerano y’ubucuruzi.

productOptions.freshEggsOrganicLarge: Amagi mashya · Manini yorowe mu buryo bw’umwimerere

myRfqsDescription: Ubusabe bwo guhabwa ibiciro watangaje hano. Ibyo waguze mu bicuruzwa byatangajwe bigaragara mu gice cy’amasezerano y’ubucuruzi.
confirmationDescription: Emeza cyangwa wange gusa ubusabe bujyanye n’ibicuruzwa washyize ku isoko.

confirmationSteps.step1: Abaguzi basaba ibicuruzwa biri ku rutonde rw’ibyo washyize ku isoko.
confirmationSteps.step2: Emeza umubare w’amakireti ahari n’igiciro utanze, cyangwa wange ubusabe.
confirmationSteps.step3: Umuguzi yishyura hashingiwe ku masezerano y’ubucuruzi yemejwe.
confirmationSteps.step4: Saba ubwikorezi igihe ubwishyu bumaze kugaragara mu masezerano y’ubucuruzi.
